app.title: AI Financial Document Intelligence Platform
app.tagline: Upload your Excel financial models — we understand them, validate them, and generate professional reports.

landing.heroTitle: Turn your Excel financial models into professional reports — with AI that understands finance
landing.heroSubtitle: Upload your feasibility study, budget or financial statements. Our specialized agents understand the structure, validate it financially and logically, and generate a polished document in Arabic or English within minutes.

understand.title: Deep structural understanding
understand.body: Automatic detection of tables, headers, merged cells and the cross-sheet formula dependency graph — zero manual setup.

validate.title: Rigorous financial validation
validate.body: Balance-sheet balance, income-statement consistency, ratio sanity — customizable rules plus circular-reference and hardcoded-number detection.

agents.title: Specialized AI agents
agents.body: An agent per task — semantic classification, validation, anomaly explanation, executive summary — with a guard that blocks any number not present in your file.

bilingual.title: Fully bilingual
bilingual.body: Professional DOCX and HTML reports in Arabic (full RTL) or English, with a customizable visual identity.

review.title: Review
review.body: Watch detected tables and validation results live
